business_problem: Kangning Massage needed a way for blind therapists to control room conditions and service timing independently because everyday tasks such as adjusting lights, curtains, and air-conditioning limited both staff autonomy and the customer experience in blind-operated stores.
solution_summary: As part of Baidu's AI blind-assistance initiative, Kangning Massage used Xiaodu smart hardware to turn one of its blind-massage shops into a voice-controlled service environment that could later be rolled out more widely. The implementation centers on a Xiaodu AI speaker connected to infrared-controllable devices in the treatment room, allowing therapists and customers to change curtains, air-conditioning, and lighting with spoken commands instead of relying on sighted helpers. The same setup also lets therapists set massage duration and receive timed reminders, improving session consistency and reducing the effort of managing service details manually. Beyond environmental control, Xiaodu's audio library gives blind users a richer companion experience inside the shop. In practice, the project removes persistent barriers inside the store, helps therapists deliver a better customer experience independently, and gives Kangning a repeatable smart-store model for future expansion.

solution_components.name: Xiaodu Smart Hardware
solution_components.role: Provides the accessible smart-device foundation used to retrofit the massage shop environment.

solution_components.name: Xiaodu AI Speaker
solution_components.role: Acts as the voice interface through which therapists and customers control in-room devices and reminders.

solution_components.name: Voice-controlled Environment Automation
solution_components.role: Connects spoken commands to curtains, lights, air-conditioning, and timed workflow reminders inside the shop.

data_flow: Therapists or customers issue voice commands to the Xiaodu speaker, which triggers environment-control actions for curtains, lights, and air-conditioning through the store's smart-device setup. The same voice workflow sets massage timers and plays reminders or audio content back to the therapist as the session progresses.
business_outcome: Kangning Massage improved therapist independence and customer experience inside blind-operated stores, created a repeatable accessible-shop model, and strengthened the broader employment mission that the business runs for blind workers.
metrics: Kangning employs more than 1,000 people, including more than 300 blind massage therapists.
The Guangzhou pilot was part of a 6-city demonstration retrofit program.
Kangning's training organization can train 400 to 500 blind therapists per year.
More than 9,000 blind people have graduated from Kangning's blind-school system.
